title: THE VANCE NETWORK: the complete mini-series

chapters.title: The High Council Dome: Cold Hook
narration: How dare you enter the High Council Dome without my permission!

chapters.title: The High Council Dome: Escalation
narration: I built these structural struts! This entire dome falls apart without my key!

chapters.title: The High Council Dome: Reveal
narration: He speaks the truth, Aurelia. He is the rightful master of the Vance Network.

chapters.title: The High Council Dome: Cliffhanger
narration: Too late, old man! The explosive charges are already armed across the outer facets!

chapters.title: The Charges: Cold Hook
narration: Cut the power and they blow. Cut me and they blow.
Choose.

chapters.title: The Charges: Escalation
narration: Then I do neither. I re-route the whole load through the base ring.

chapters.title: The Charges: Reveal
narration: The base ring was never rated for that. He is gambling with the whole shell.

chapters.title: The Charges: Cliffhanger
narration: My father is watching. If it cracks, the Network takes this dome back tonight.

chapters.title: The Base Ring: Cold Hook
narration: It held. Every strut he touched is standing, and the Council saw it hold.

chapters.title: The Base Ring: Escalation
narration: A mechanic who saves a dome is still a mechanic. Sign the release.

chapters.title: The Base Ring: Reveal
narration: He signs nothing. The original blueprints name him, and I kept them.

chapters.title: The Base Ring: Cliffhanger
narration: Paper burns, old man. Ask me how I know that.

chapters.title: The Originals: Cold Hook
narration: Twelve rolls of vellum. One match.
Say the word, heiress.

chapters.title: The Originals: Escalation
narration: The word is no. And you were never the one holding the match.

chapters.title: The Originals: Reveal
narration: She copied every sheet the night the Council sealed the vault.

chapters.title: The Originals: Cliffhanger
narration: Then we do this the old way. Convene the vote.
Tonight.

chapters.title: The Vote: Cold Hook
narration: Ninety per cent of this Network answers to me. Count it and be done.

chapters.title: The Vote: Escalation
narration: Count the domes instead. Forty of them went up under my hands.

chapters.title: The Vote: Reveal
narration: The charter counts builders, Vance. It always did.
Read clause nine.

chapters.title: The Vote: Cliffhanger
narration: Then he does not need your name. He already has mine.

chapters.title: The Name: Cold Hook
narration: You gave a mechanic your name. You gave away the whole Network.

chapters.title: The Name: Escalation
narration: I gave it to the only person here who ever fixed anything.

chapters.title: The Name: Reveal
narration: The Network is not a name. It is sixty-five struts and everyone who cut them.

chapters.title: The Name: Cliffhanger
narration: Beautiful speech. Shame about the second set of charges.

chapters.title: Do the one thing
narration: If any of this was worth your time, send it to one person who can
carry it further than I can. That is the whole ask. One share from
somebody with reach does more for this than a month of me in a field
with a chainsaw.

chapters.title: Follow the experiments
narration: Everything is documented, including the parts that failed.
